Crop the center#

def center_crop(x, size):
    start = (x.shape[1] - size) // 2
    return x[:, start:start+size, start:start+size]

movies32 = center_crop(movies, 32)
movies16 = center_crop(movies, 16)

movies16.shape, movies32.shape

((171170, 16, 16), (171170, 32, 32))

show_movie(movies32[range(1800, 1900)])

show_movie(movies16[range(1800, 1900)])

Save npy#

to_save = {
    'movies16': movies16,
    'movies32': movies32,
    'movies64': movies,
    'eye_pos': eye_pos,
    't_samples': t_samples,
    'trials': trials,
}

for name, x in to_save.items():
    save_obj(
        obj=x,
        file_name=name,
        save_dir=root,
        mode='npy',
        verbose=True,
    )
